definitions.VR: 1 - Var(corrected pair difference) / Var(raw pair difference); centered variance
definitions.R2: 1 - mean(corrected pair difference squared) / Var(raw pair difference); distinct from centered VR
definitions.F0_nonflip: Fraction of F0 pairs with equal left/right prediction signs; distinct from both-correct
definitions.ER: Mean truth-direction response after correction / before correction; undefined at zero denominator
definitions.correction: Corrected pair difference minus raw pair difference
definitions.MEGA_interference_unit: Correction RMS divided by raw MEGA A/P RMS
definitions.scope: Behavioral pair dependence and evidence response; no assertion about internal reasoning or chain-of-thought faithfulness

mega.sample_identity: Existing train_val source-held-out subset previously used for legacy and optimization evaluations; not the newly expanded official test

uncertainty.interpretation: Sources resampled jointly across all fixed trained methods; sparse-group undefined draws omitted; not training-seed uncertainty

nli.scope: Native robustness/response under frozen MEGA-to-NLI zero-shot transfer; these groups are not MEGA A/P/C/F

uncertainty.grouping: native base family within each original split, using families present in the pair CSV
uncertainty.qualification: Variants share their base; different families may share trial material. These are not independent patients.
